cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've circled five names like you. Priority guests for our first supper club.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Those are cancellations. Only one person's left on the list.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. One committed diner. We've refined it to a private-chef experience.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the printer. He only wants his invoice paid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even more exclusive: supper with our only supplier. Ask if he'll take payment over dessert.

reason: Copy cancellation marks as selected guests, then celebrate actual shrinking attendance and invoice visit as progressive exclusivity.
